ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. Where is the Library
   D. Where is the library

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goed
   C. going
   D. goes

3. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

4. When practising Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.

5. When practising Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.

8. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. run
   B. happiness
   C. blue
   D. quickly

9. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.

10. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Only one word repeated
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. No full stops
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

11. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
